summary: Iteration 20 — Onboarding iteration-4 fixes verified. Backend regression PASSES: 44/44 onboarding tests green (test_onboarding_tips.py + test_onboarding_backfill.py + test_onboarding_backfill_v2.py) against preview backend. (b) create-post.tsx Tip-3 uses onboardingRef + completionTipTriggeredRef + targetRects state + 800ms setTimeout that calls measureInWindow on mediaRowRef / editableStatsRowRef / igButtonRef, deps `[]`. (c) attachmentCard wrapped with `ref={mediaRowRef} collapsable={false}` at line 1517, IG TouchableOpacity with `ref={igButtonRef} collapsable={false}` at 1794-1796, editableStatsRow with `ref={editableStatsRowRef} collapsable={false}` at 1852. (e) create-post invocation at 2262-2286 passes `targets=[{rect: targetRects.media,...},{rect: targetRects.stats,...},{rect: targetRects.ig,...}]` (NOT `pointers`). (f) handleShareToInstagram at 850-904 is fully hardened: top-level try {…} catch {…} finally {…}, single-flight `if (isExportingToInstagram) return` at line 854, finally block resets isExportingToInstagram + cleans up igPromptResolveRef + setIgPromptVisible(false), covers both web html2canvas (863-881) and native shareToInstagramStoriesDirect (883) paths. Frontend smoke test: Expo bundles cleanly via Metro (Web Bundled 1685ms, zero syntax/import errors), localhost:3000 loads to Terms & Privacy gate with no pageerrors (only the expected by-design 'Rejecting preview env URL' warning).

critical_code_review_comments: create-post.tsx is now 3176 lines (grew from 3140 in iter-17/18/19) — this file urgently needs splitting into ShareAchievementForm, MediaPicker, EditableStats, and InstagramShare modules; the OnboardingOverlay/measure logic adds ~50 more lines on top of an already over-budget file.

OnboardingOverlay PointerCallout uses a hardcoded CARD_H_EST=92 to compute card-above placement (line 133). For long body copy like 'Saves the overlay to your photo album. Then open Instagram → new Story → sticker icon → pick the saved overlay.' the actual rendered height likely exceeds 92, which on the 'IG' target (placed above on iPhone) will cause the arrow to start mid-card instead of at the card bottom. Consider onLayout-based dynamic height or text-length-aware estimate.

create-post.tsx targetRects measurement runs ONCE in the 800ms timer (line 162-180). If the screen scrolls or rotates after the overlay shows, the pointers will go stale. Acceptable for an onboarding tip (user dismisses on tap), but worth a comment for future maintainers.

handleShareToInstagram's catch block at 885-894 swallows the original error after logging — fine for not crashing the screen, but the user-facing message 'The overlay may have been saved to your photo album' is misleading if the capture failed BEFORE the save step. Consider branching the alert on which stage threw.

workout-session.tsx line 51-53: storing context in a ref via `useEffect(()=>{ ref.current = onboarding }, [onboarding])` works, but is a code-smell pattern. Long-term, splitting OnboardingProvider so its `requestRender`/`trackShown`/`markCompleted` callbacks are stable (useCallback w/ no deps that change) would eliminate the need for the ref-based workaround in TWO files.
